:::{#def-finite-additivity}
#### Finite additivity

Let $\salg$ be a [$\sigma$-algebra](#def-sigma-algebra) on a set $S$.
A [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) $\measure : \salg \to [0, \infty]$,
with values in the [extended non-negative reals](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-extended-nonneg-reals),
is **finitely additive**
[@wikipedia_sigma_additive_set_function]
if, for every finite collection of
[pairwise disjoint](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-pairwise-disjoint) [sets](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-set) $\dsn{A}$ in $\salg$,
the value of their union is the sum of their values:

$$\measure(A_1 \cup \cdots \cup A_n) = \sumin \measure(A_i)$$

:::
